lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense array of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in approximate vertical columns following faint dermal banding.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, forming a non-uniform grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from a high-luminance upper edge to a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical gill slits on the anterior lateral flank; a small dark teleost fish is visible trailing the mid-lateral section.
